question: In the prologue (उपकथा), what does the narrator say determines whether the old legends are true or false, and why doesn't that matter?
actual_answer: The narrator says ancient tales have lost their connection to our own lived, personal experience, so they become free from the ordinary measure of truth and falsehood. He does not investigate how much of their account is factual; their importance lies only in the symbolic and suggestive interest they create. He compares this to a sage said to live ten thousand years or a painter's red sun on paper — neither is scientifically true, yet both function as meaningful symbols. The story's worth is thus mythic and symbolic, not something to be weighed on a scale of fact.

question: सूर्यदत्त र उनकी पत्नीले आफ्नो छोरा सोमदत्तलाई किन वनमा लगेर हुर्काउने निर्णय गरे?
actual_answer: उनीहरूलाई विश्वास थियो कि गाउँमा राखेर हुर्काउँदा छोराको शिक्षाको राम्रो व्यवस्था हुन सक्दैन, तर वनमा कठोर अनुशासन र उच्च जीवनको शिक्षा दिँदा ऊ आदिकालका ऋषिहरूकै समकक्षी बन्न सक्छ भन्ने उनीहरूको दृढ धारणा थियो। साथै सोमदत्त सानैदेखि मेधावी, अद्भुत स्मरणशक्ति भएको र एकपटक सुनेको श्लोक कण्ठस्थ गर्न सक्ने भएकाले मातापिताले उसबाट ठूलो आशा राखेका थिए।

question: Where did Somdutta and Sumnima first meet, and what was Sumnima's reaction upon seeing him?
actual_answer: They first met on the bank of the Koshi river, under a large shami tree, while Somdutta was out grazing his cow and had fallen asleep there in an awkward position. Seeing an unfamiliar boy with a matted topknot, a body smeared with sacred ash, and a sacred thread and loincloth, Sumnima — herself completely unclothed, as was customary for Kirati people — stood there astonished, curious, and increasingly intrigued by his unusual appearance.

question: सोमदत्त र सुम्निमाबीच "आमा" र "माता" शब्दलाई लिएर के विवाद भयो?
actual_answer: सोमदत्तले आफ्नी आमालाई "माता" भनेकोमा सुम्निमाले प्रश्न गरिन् — किन सजिलो र न्यानो शब्द "आमा" प्रयोग नगरी टाढा लाग्ने "माता" भनिन्छ। सोमदत्तले जवाफ दिए कि "माता" शब्दले आदर र कृतज्ञता व्यक्त गर्छ र दैहिक सम्बन्धभन्दा माथि उठेको उच्च मर्यादा दिन्छ, जबकि सुम्निमाले यसलाई अनावश्यक टाढापन र बनावटी संस्कार भनी आलोचना गरिन् र भावनालाई धरतीको यथार्थसँगै जोडिनुपर्ने तर्क गरिन्।

question: Why did Ram and Lakshman never visit sage Vishwamitra's ashram at Chatara, despite being his disciples?
actual_answer: According to the legend recounted in the prologue, Vishwamitra likely wished to one day show his talented disciples his ashram, but their journey was interrupted when they reached Janakpur, where Ram won Sita's hand in marriage by proving his skill and valor. After the wedding, the situation changed entirely — Ram and Lakshman returned directly to their capital Ayodhya with Sita instead of continuing on to Vishwamitra's ashram, so the land of Chatara was permanently deprived of that great honor.

question: राजकुमार आश्रममा किन आएका थिए, र उनले किराती-भिल्लहरूलाई के आदेश दिए?
actual_answer: राजकुमार मृगया (शिकार) खेल्न सेनासहित वनमा आएका थिए, र नजिकै तपस्वी ब्राह्मण परिवारको आश्रम रहेको थाहा पाएपछि तपोभूमिको शान्ति भङ्ग नहोस् भनी सेना टाढै छाडेर दर्शन गर्न आए। किराती र भिल्लहरूले गोवध र हिंसा गरेर तपोभूमिको पवित्रता बिगारेको सुनेपछि उनले राजाज्ञाद्वारा त्यस क्षेत्रमा गोवध र कुनै पनि प्रकारको हिंसा निषेध गरे।

question: What compromise did Suryadutta propose regarding the Kirati and Bhilla people's worship site, and what name did the place receive as a result?
actual_answer: When the prince's ban on violence upset the Kirati and Bhilla people, who needed to sacrifice a pig at their hilltop worship site, Suryadutta intervened and told them they could keep that site for their worship, only asking that they not kill a pig (सुँगुर) there. As a result, that place came to be called "Varahkshetra," said to commemorate the varaha (boar) incarnation described in their Puranas.

question: बिजुवाले सभामा किराती-भिल्लहरूले आश्रम निर्माणमा गरेको योगदानबारे के भने?
actual_answer: बिजुवाले भने कि उनीहरूले नै ब्राह्मण परिवारलाई आश्रम खडा गर्न मद्दत गरेका थिए — वन फाँडेर ठाउँ दिएका थिए, कुटीलाई चाहिने सरसामान जुटाएका थिए, आफ्नो जनबल लगाएर सबै कुटीहरू खडा गरेका थिए, गाउँकै सबैभन्दा बढी दूध दिने भरखर बियाएकी काली गाई चढाएका थिए, र हरबखत चाहिने अरू सरसामानको जोहो पनि मिलाइदिने गरेका थिए।

question: What happened to Sumnima at the end of this excerpt, and why was she so distressed?
actual_answer: While the tribal assembly was taking place at the ashram, Sumnima was away at the riverbank all day waiting for Somdutta, so she missed the gathering entirely. When she finally returned home in the evening, she found the house empty — her parents had gone to the assembly. Finding no one at home and unable to find Somdutta either, she suddenly felt frighteningly alone in the world, and cried out repeatedly for her mother, father, and Somdutta until her parents finally returned.

question: पर्णकुटीहरू र विश्वामित्रको आश्रमको अन्त्य कसरी भयो भनी उपकथामा वर्णन गरिएको छ?
actual_answer: विश्वामित्रको मृत्युपछि आश्रमको यज्ञवेदी निभ्न गयो र यज्ञधूम रोकियो, वेदपाठ पनि थामियो। आश्रमका पर्णकुटीहरू केही समय शून्यमा उभिरहे, अनि बिस्तारै भूमिसात् हुँदै लोप भए। नजिकैको वनले बिस्तारै त्यो स्थललाई फेरि आफूभित्र समेट्यो, र किराती-भिल्लहरूको स्मृतिबाटसमेत विश्वामित्र र उनको आश्रमको चहलपहल पूर्णतया मेटियो, कुनै चिह्न नछोडी।
